purpose: Implement the remaining shared platform worker envelope so architecture-specific or risky downstream tool work can be routed through an explicitly identified isolated worker with exact request/result truth, without pretending the main N0TE process can load every architecture or format directly.

lineage.outcome: N0TE can preserve one native main-app architecture while representing native and explicit isolated foreign-architecture worker routes truthfully; wrong worker/target/capability and crashed/timed-out/unknown results cannot masquerade as success.
lineage.capability: Architecture-isolated worker identity, route and result envelope

legacy_rejections: stale result accepted for another request
crash or timeout translated into generic failure/success
worker envelope treated as plugin hosting

completion_proof: WorkerIdentity fingerprint changes with worker kind/platform/architecture/build artifact
WorkerRequest binds exact worker fingerprint, support target fingerprint, job, format, workload architecture, payload fingerprint and positive timeout budget
request for another worker, target, OS family, job, format or undeclared workload architecture is rejected before dispatch
NATIVE_ONLY route requires worker architecture and workload architecture to match the application target

ISOLATED_FOREIGN_ARCH may represent a foreign architecture only when the worker capability explicitly declares that workload architecture and the workload matches the worker architecture on the same OS family
explicit bridge route never changes or rewrites the main application target architecture
SUCCEEDED result requires exact request/worker binding, evidence reference, result fingerprint and receipt reference
FAILED, CRASHED, TIMED_OUT and UNKNOWN remain distinct and cannot carry success receipt/result fields
result from another request or worker is rejected
request fingerprint is deterministic and capability architecture lists canonicalize
worker envelope exposes only plan and validate_result; no subprocess/spawn/IPC/load/process-audio/install/kill/execute/connect behavior exists
